subject.title: fix(mattermost): keep finalized preview when a trailing tool-error warning falls back

question: Should Mattermost preserve the finalized reply by guarding destructive clear in this PR, or should it stop supplying the consumed draft as proposed in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/109555?
rationale: Both branches address the evidenced bug inside the Mattermost owner boundary, but they express different permanent draft-lifecycle contracts and only one should become canonical.

options.title: Use consumed-draft invariant
options.body: Prefer the competing shape that stops supplying the draft after finalization, then require real Mattermost proof before landing and close the other branch.

options.title: Use guarded clear
options.body: Keep this narrower patch, require real Mattermost proof, and document through tests that finalized drafts may remain supplied while destructive cleanup is disabled.

recommendation.title: Use consumed-draft invariant
recommendation.body: Prefer the competing shape that stops supplying the draft after finalization, then require real Mattermost proof before landing and close the other branch.

likelyOwner.reason: They merged and later hardened the Mattermost channel surface and are the strongest available history-based owner for selecting the canonical lifecycle shape.
